d: Tom Nolan delivered a standout performance to defeat Renato Moicano by TKO in the main event at UFC Fight Night. After a competitive opening round, Nolan found his rhythm with sharp striking and powerful combinations. He continued his offensive attack in the third round, landing a series of punches and elbows to force the referee to stop the contest at 1:28. The victory marked the biggest win of Nolan’s UFC career.
